release_notes:
v2.3.3 — Job-based print folders and a routing fix

• New: each print destination can now be set to "By Job" in Settings so every order for the same job lands in one shared folder, instead of being split out per order
• Fixed: a plain print and a specialty product of the same size (e.g. a 5x7 print vs. a 5x7 hardboard mount) could silently share one routing entry — making one invisible in Discover Products and, if downloaded, sent to the wrong destination
• Renamed the "Printer" settings label to "Receipt Printer" for clarity
